## 2. Regressio task

### 2.1 Variable Selection and Transformation

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(boot)
library(glmnet)
library(broom)
```

```{r data-import}
train <- read.table("./data/403_train.dat", header = TRUE)
test1 <- read.table("./data/403_test-1.dat", header = TRUE)
test2 <- read.table("./data/403_test-2.dat", header = TRUE)

selected_vars <- train[, c(
  "log10price", "sqft_living", "bathrooms",
  "yr_built", "grade", "condition", "sqft_lot15"
)]
```


```{r transformations, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
train <- train %>%
```

### 2.2 Final Model Specification

```{r final-model}
final_formula <- log10price ~ log_sqft_living +
  sqrt_bathrooms + yr_built_c + grade +
  condition + log_sqft_lot15

model_final <- lm(final_formula, data = train)

summary(model_final)
```

### 2.3 Model Performance and Interpretation

```{r model-performance}
pred_final <- predict(model_final, newdata = train)

mse_final <- mean((train$log10price - pred_final)^2)

cat("OLS training MSE:", mse_final, "\n")

cat(
  "Adjusted R-squared:",
  summary(model_final)$adj.r.squared,
  "\n"
)

beta_grade <- coef(model_final)["grade"]
beta_living <- coef(model_final)["log_sqft_living"]

cat(
  "Price change for +1 grade (%):",
  100 * (10^beta_grade - 1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Approximate price change for +1% living area (%):",
  100 * (10^(beta_living * log(1.01)) - 1),
  "\n"
)
```

### 2.4 Confidence Interval Construction

```{r confidence-intervals}
boot_fn <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, , drop = FALSE]
  coef(lm(final_formula, data = d))
}

set.seed(123)

boot_out <- boot(
  data = train,
  statistic = boot_fn,
  R = 1000
)

boot_cis <- lapply(
  seq_along(coef(model_final)),
  function(i) {
    boot.ci(boot_out, type = "perc", index = i)
  }
)

names(boot_cis) <- names(coef(model_final))

gaussian_ci <- confint(model_final) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  rename(
    gauss_lower = `2.5 %`,
    gauss_upper = `97.5 %`
  )

boot_ci <- tibble(
  term = names(boot_cis),
  boot_lower = map_dbl(boot_cis, ~ .x$percent[4]),
  boot_upper = map_dbl(boot_cis, ~ .x$percent[5])
)

combined_ci <- left_join(
  gaussian_ci,
  boot_ci,
  by = "term"
)

combined_ci
```

```{r confidence-interval-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
estimates <- tidy(model_final)[, c("term", "estimate")]

ci_df <- estimates %>%
  left_join(gaussian_ci, by = "term") %>%
  left_join(boot_ci, by = "term") %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

ci_long <- ci_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      gauss_lower,
      gauss_upper,
      boot_lower,
      boot_upper
    ),
    names_to = c("type", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = dplyr::recode(
      type,
      gauss = "Gaussian",
      boot = "Bootstrap"
    )
  )

ci_plot <- ggplot(
  ci_long,
  aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = type)
) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "95% Confidence Intervals: Gaussian vs Bootstrap",
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Coefficient Estimate",
    color = "CI Type"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()

print(ci_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "figures/CI_Plot.pdf",
  plot = ci_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
```

### 2.6 Comparison with Penalized Models

```{r penalized-models}
X <- model.matrix(
  final_formula,
  data = train
)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

y <- train$log10price

set.seed(123)

foldid <- sample(
  rep(seq_len(10), length.out = nrow(X))
)

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  X,
  y,
  alpha = 1,
  foldid = foldid
)

pred_lasso <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    cv_lasso,
    newx = X,
    s = "lambda.min"
  )
)

mse_lasso <- mean((y - pred_lasso)^2)

cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  X,
  y,
  alpha = 0,
  foldid = foldid
)

pred_ridge <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    cv_ridge,
    newx = X,
    s = "lambda.min"
  )
)

mse_ridge <- mean((y - pred_ridge)^2)

mse_df <- tibble(
  Model = c("OLS", "Lasso", "Ridge"),
  Training_MSE = c(
    mse_final,
    mse_lasso,
    mse_ridge
  )
)

print(mse_df)
```

## 3 Jackknife+ Implementation with alpha = 0.05

```{r jackknife-distributions, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
par(mfrow = c(2, 4), mar = c(4, 3, 2, 1))

hist(train$sqft_living,
     main = "Living Area", xlab = "sqft_living")

hist(train$sqft_basement,
     main = "Basement", xlab = "sqft_basement")

hist(train$bathrooms,
     main = "Bathrooms", xlab = "bathrooms")

hist(train$sqft_lot,
     main = "Lot Area", xlab = "sqft_lot")

hist(log1p(train$sqft_living),
     main = "Log Living Area", xlab = "log1p(sqft_living)")

hist(log1p(train$sqft_basement),
     main = "Log Basement", xlab = "log1p(sqft_basement)")

hist(sqrt(train$bathrooms),
     main = "Sqrt Bathrooms", xlab = "sqrt(bathrooms)")

hist(log1p(train$sqft_lot),
     main = "Log Lot Area", xlab = "log1p(sqft_lot)")

dev.copy(
  pdf,
  file = "figures/skewness.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 6
)
dev.off()

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r train_jack}
train_jack <- train %>%
  transmute(
    log10price,
    log_sqft_living = log1p(sqft_living),
    sqrt_bathrooms = sqrt(bathrooms),
    log_sqft_basement = log1p(sqft_basement),
    log_sqft_lot = log1p(sqft_lot)
  )

X_train <- dplyr::select(
  train_jack,
  -log10price
)

y_train <- train_jack$log10price
```

```{r test2}
test_jack <- test2 %>%
  transmute(
    log_sqft_living = log1p(sqft_living),
    sqrt_bathrooms = sqrt(bathrooms),
    log_sqft_basement = log1p(sqft_basement),
    log_sqft_lot = log1p(sqft_lot)
  )

X_test <- test_jack

n <- nrow(X_train)
m <- nrow(X_test)

jack_preds <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = n,
  ncol = m
)

jack_residuals <- numeric(n)

for (k in seq_len(n)) {

  fit_k <- lm(
    y ~ .,
    data = data.frame(
      y = y_train[-k],
      X_train[-k, , drop = FALSE]
    )
  )

  jack_preds[k, ] <- predict(
    fit_k,
    newdata = X_test
  )

  yhat_k <- predict(
    fit_k,
    newdata = X_train[k, , drop = FALSE]
  )

  jack_residuals[k] <- abs(
    y_train[k] - yhat_k
  )
}

alpha <- 0.05

CI_log10 <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = m,
  ncol = 2
)

# Conservative finite-sample Jackknife+ order-statistic endpoints.
# alpha/2 targets a 1-alpha coverage lower bound
# via the standard 1-2*delta guarantee.

lower_rank <- max(
  1L,
  floor((n + 1) * alpha / 2)
)

upper_rank <- min(
  n,
  ceiling((n + 1) * (1 - alpha / 2))
)

for (j in seq_len(m)) {

  lower_candidates <- jack_preds[, j] - jack_residuals
  upper_candidates <- jack_preds[, j] + jack_residuals

  CI_log10[j, ] <- c(
    sort(lower_candidates)[lower_rank],
    sort(upper_candidates)[upper_rank]
  )
}

CI_price <- 10^CI_log10

colnames(CI_price) <- c(
  "lower",
  "upper"
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(CI_price) == nrow(test2),
  all(CI_price[, 1] <= CI_price[, 2])
)

head(CI_price)

interval_width <- CI_price[, "upper"] -
  CI_price[, "lower"]

summary(interval_width)
```
